'''Amyva Va'new''' was an [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] cook, who lived in [[Nashal]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
In about [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] approached Va'new on the advice of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Hunde Decan]], to try and find out how to repair a [[Corellian Fried Ice Cream Fryer]]. Va'new told the spacer to that [[Mikfa Faaus]], a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] who lived on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], might be able to give them more information about the fryer.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Amyva Va'new was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FonatF" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Amyva Va'new was added to the game along with the [[W:c:swg:Portable Deep Fryer|"Portable Deep Fryer" collection]] introduced with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 9 Notes for April 3 2008|Chapter 9]],"<ref>{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67692&month=042008|text=Weekly Picks – 4/3/08 - 04/03/2008}}</ref> published on [[April 3]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67688&month=042008|text=Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun}}</ref>

Amyva Va'new was part of the quest line ''"Find out more about the Cooker"'' (and the interconnected [[:w:c:swg:Collection|Collection]] [[:w:c:swg:CollectionPortable Deep Fryer|Portable Deep Fryer]]) that started when the player inspects a [[:w:c:swg:Broken Fryer|broken ice cream fryer]]. The player then had to talk to several NPCs on different planets to gather more information about the fryer. When he finished the quest, the player was rewarded with a schematic for a Corellian Fried Ice Cream Fryer.
